text.p: British facilites management and construction group Amey Plc said on Tuesday it had been awarded a contract to design, build, finance and operate a three-lane motorway at a total operating cost of 370 million stg.
The motorway would link the M6 at Carlisle to the M74 at Millbank, covering a length of 120 km, the company said in a statement.

New works costing 200 million stg, including the completion of the M6 motorway in the south of Scotland and the upgrading of the remaining 30 km stretch of the A74, will commence in Spring 1997 and be completed by 2000.
Babtie Group and Gibb Ltd have been appointed design consultants for the project. Morgan Stanley and Ashurst Morris Crisp are financial and legal advisers respectively.
